description:
COLD-REVIEWED ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES (2026-09-01, dedicated review at
b32d645ac; artifacts scratchpad rev119/: proto3-final.patch = the
Scope-A shape, proto119/proto2 = refuted variants, probes, sweeps).
BOTH halves of the earlier spec REFUTED; the goal upgraded.

THE P1 JUSTIFICATION (live, source-only, no stdlib, both doors):
annot_tag2.fz -- two clauses annotated {:cont,integer}/{:halt,integer},
a pick() returning either -- prints 1 1 (or 2 2 with clauses swapped)
on interp AND run. The PLAN is correct (n4 tests {:cont,int}, n2 tests
{:halt,int}); the PROJECTION is blind ('is a 2-tuple'). Annotation-
based multi-clause dispatch on tagged tuples is broken for every user
who writes it. Fix locus: the projection + its THREE lowerings
(ir_interp/backend.rs:652 select_dispatch_match;
native_codegen/prim.rs:1121; native_codegen/receive.rs:611) -- never
the matcher or plan.

SCOPE A SPEC (one commit -- HARD CONSTRAINT, review-reproduced: the
predicate refinement without the lowerings reseats
enum_predicate_search unsoundly and the corpus does not notice; there
is no safe intermediate):
1. tuple_arities: FiniteSet<usize> -> tuples: TupleShapes
   { shapes: Vec<Vec<RuntimeTypePredicate>>, exact: bool } -- one
   shape per Descr tuple CLAUSE (preserves cross-position correlation;
   never re-join what the lattice kept apart -- the fz-kdt.126
   defect); exact=false degrades to arity-only when any clause has
   pos.len()!=1 or non-empty neg. Keep an arities() projection for
   the four oracle sites (jobs/transport.rs:2158,2312;
   jobs/runtime_demand.rs:2882; ir_interp/value.rs:166 -- which must
   also register NESTED tuple schema ids). NOT FiniteSet<(arity,tag)>
   (three refutations: cofinite meaningless; element-equality ops
   can't do pointwise; union containment incomplete). NOT a 'tag'
   concept -- an atom position's sub-predicate IS its tag set; the
   fold subsumes the special case.
2. Lattice ops per the review's four equations (shapes_overlap /
   tuple_overlap / tuple_contains_all / tuple_erasing_overlap).
   NESTED LIST POSITIONS REPORT ERASING (the Scope-A carve-out,
   AUTHORIZED as scoped-and-ticketed: Scope B is blocked by the
   take_drop dead-and-broken specialization ticket; the P1<->P3 delta
   proved the boundary is exactly nested lists).
3. runtime_type_test_envelope: apply callable_identity_clauses
   RECURSIVELY inside runtime_envelope's structural recursion --
   IDENTITY-PRESERVING, never fun_top (the fun_top reading reproduces
   fz-kdt.125's Pipeline defect one tuple deep and creates an
   indefensible depth-0/depth-1 seam). {:tag,#66(int)} vs
   {:tag,#66(float)} honestly collapse (captures erased at depth =
   fz-kdt.127 population grows, recorded there); {:tag,#66} vs
   {:tag,#68} become separable. Nested-callable testing is CHEAP:
   fz_struct_get_field_ref (exists) + the 125 closure_code_ref
   compare -- new test SITE not shape; interp recurses through a
   TupleFieldReader mirroring CallableIdentities (prototyped green).
4. All three lowerings in the same commit; FOLD the two duplicate
   native emitters (prim.rs/receive.rs emit_runtime_type_predicate_*)
   FIRST or in the same motion.
5. DELETE-OR-REPAIR the delivered_tuple_field_arity fast path
   (prim.rs:1176): it answers the whole type test with a CONSTANT
   from lane arity under destination-passing -- wrong and silent once
   the predicate is payload-aware; the field params it counts are
   exactly the values the per-field test needs.
6. INVARIANT GATE: every axis overlaps_on_an_erasing_axis treats as
   exact is decided by ALL THREE lowerings -- one shared table, read
   by each.

GATES: red-first fixture dispatch_annotated_tuple_tag_clauses from
annot_tag2 (both clause orders, three doors, Elixir oracle; RED at
base on interp AND run); halt.fz + enum_reduce_halt_arm_order under
the reversal knob both orders; REWRITE (not re-pin) the four gates
whose premise this deletes (a_narrower_twin_..._is_no_destination:
Direct becomes an honest 2-arm Dispatch -- fz-kdt.118's headline
REVERSED, sound both ways, its framing inverted;
distinguishable_arms_... wide-first reasoning now false -- precision
seats narrow first once questions differ;
runtime_indistinguishable_..._keep_arrival needs a genuinely
inseparable example, list elements or same-fn-id;
types_test::..._projects_tuple_and_list_shapes mechanical). Re-pin
inventory 4929->4971 WITH CAUSE (the +42 = three receive_* fixtures'
dbg specs going 1->8 per function -- the 2^arity per-position product;
fz-kdt.123's arms-become-LIVE at scale; handed to fz-3bb); re-price
those fixtures' budget headers. Land the DYNAMIC surface-membership
tripwire (FZ_STRESS_ASSERT_SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP -- found 10 fixtures
with values passing tests their arm's surface never named, in one
pass). A corpus stdout sweep is NOT a gate (fourth demonstration).
FIFO/LIFO must be measured in-build (unmeasured by the review).

CENSUS CORRECTIONS: retires ZERO of the 19 blind escapes (all list
subjects = 107 step 3's alone); DOES split three receive fixtures
(census note '(1) separates zero in-corpus groups' refuted).
REFNEST acceptance probe UNCONSTRUCTIBLE today (compiles on no path,
pre-existing; own ticket, related fz-kdt.127). The generalized-drop
amendment (covers-based unroutable_alternatives) was prototyped and
REFUTED (kills the :timeout-beside-any precision arm + 7 more; drop
is a de-specialization decision once something separates) -- do not
re-propose; proto2-droprule.patch is the negative result.
title: P1: the tuple axis becomes per-position sub-predicate shapes; the envelope erases identity-preserving at every depth (Scope A; nested lists stay erasing pending the take_drop blocker)
